name: Polypropylene film, packaging
source: Polypropylene repeat unit (C3H6)n, monomer mass 42.081 from IUPAC standard atomic weights (C 12.011 x3, H 1.008 x6). C fraction of the polymer backbone 36.033/42.081 = 85.6303%.
notes: 997000000 ug/kg is backbone (C3H6)n split by monomer ratio; the remaining 3000000 ug/kg (0.3%) is the typical mass share of processing additives in commercial film (slip agents, antioxidants, anti-block) and is carried entirely in Ash since its own composition is not tracked here. H is set to close the remainder exactly.
